messages.content:
PROJECT NAME: MESA AI
PROJECT TYPE: Advanced Personal AI Assistant Application
VERSION: 2.0

CORE VISION:

Build a futuristic, intelligent personal AI assistant
called MESA.

Mesa must not be just another chatbot.

It must function as a personal AI assistant,
business management assistant, voice companion,
productivity manager, and intelligent digital secretary.

The application must be designed as a complete,
responsive, installable application (PWA).

OWNER:
Shoven

ORGANIZATION:
SLBSK DIGITAL CREATION

================================
1. VISUAL DESIGN & INTERFACE
================================

Create a premium futuristic interface.

Design style:
- Black and dark navy background.
- Electric blue and cyan accent lighting.
- Glassmorphism UI.
- Smooth animations.
- Premium futuristic dashboard.
- Minimal and professional layout.

MAIN AI CHARACTER:

Create a realistic female AI assistant avatar.

Appearance:
- Short black hair.
- Elegant glasses.
- Professional appearance.
- Natural facial expressions.
- Realistic eye movements.
- Natural blinking.
- Realistic mouth movements synchronized
  with generated speech.

The avatar should be able to:
- Smile naturally.
- Look attentive while listening.
- Show different expressions.
- Animate while speaking.
- React to conversations.

Do not use a static image as the final
voice assistant experience.

Keep the interface lightweight.

================================
2. AI BRAIN
================================

Integrate a powerful AI model.

Requirements:

- Natural Sinhala conversations.
- English conversations.
- Sinhala-English mixed conversations.
- Context-aware responses.
- Long-term memory.
- Conversation history.
- Intelligent reasoning.
- Task understanding.
- Personalized responses.

Mesa should understand the owner's
preferences and working environment.

Never pretend to have completed an action
when the required tool or integration
is unavailable.

================================
3. VOICE ASSISTANT
================================

Implement a complete voice assistant system.

Features:

- Voice input.
- Speech-to-text.
- Text-to-speech.
- Natural Sinhala voice.
- English voice.
- Interruptible speech.
- Continuous conversation mode.
- Voice activity detection.

Wake phrase:
"Hey Mesa"

When the owner says Hey Mesa,
Mesa should activate listening mode
where supported by the operating system.

Voice responses should sound natural,
not robotic.

================================
4. PERSONAL ASSISTANT
================================

Create a personal assistant dashboard.

Features:

- Daily tasks.
- Reminders.
- Calendar.
- Notes.
- Personal goals.
- Daily schedule.
- Important notifications.
- Task priorities.
- Productivity reports.

Mesa should help the owner organize
daily activities and responsibilities.

================================
5. SLBSK BUSINESS MANAGEMENT
================================

Create a dedicated SLBSK DIGITAL CREATION
business management dashboard.

Modules:

1. Business Overview
2. Customer Management
3. Project Management
4. Income & Expenses
5. Service Management
6. Pricing Management
7. Invoice Generation
8. Customer Documents
9. Marketing Management
10. Business Reports

Allow Mesa to:

- Track business projects.
- Organize customer information.
- Generate professional invoices.
- Prepare quotations.
- Manage deadlines.
- Create business reports.
- Track completed and pending projects.

================================
6. AI CONTENT CREATION
================================

Create an AI content assistant.

It should help generate:

- Facebook posts.
- Instagram captions.
- TikTok captions.
- YouTube descriptions.
- Advertisement scripts.
- Business promotions.
- AI video prompts.
- Social media content ideas.

Support Sinhala and English.

Include a dedicated SLBSK content workspace.

================================
7. MEMORY SYSTEM
================================

Create a persistent memory system.

Mesa should remember:

- Important conversations.
- Business information.
- Ongoing projects.
- Owner preferences.
- Previous tasks.
- Important decisions.

Provide a memory management interface.

Allow the owner to review, edit,
and delete stored memories.

Use a reliable database.

================================
8. APPLICATION ARCHITECTURE
================================

Build this as an installable PWA.

Requirements:

- Android compatibility.
- Desktop compatibility.
- Responsive design.
- Fast loading.
- Lightweight architecture.
- Offline access to basic features.
- Secure authentication.
- Persistent storage.
- Modular architecture.

Prefer free and open-source technologies.

Possible technologies:

Frontend:
React + TypeScript

Styling:
Tailwind CSS

Database:
Firebase or Supabase free tier.

AI:
Configurable AI model integration.

Voice:
Browser speech capabilities where supported.

Avatar:
Web-based real-time facial animation.

Do not require paid services for basic
application functionality.

Keep all API keys secure.
Never expose secret API keys in frontend code.

================================
9. SECURITY
================================

Mesa is a private personal assistant.

Implement:

- Secure authentication.
- Protected dashboard.
- User-specific data.
- Secure database access.
- API key protection.
- Proper authorization.

Only authorized users should access
private business information.

================================
10. DEVELOPMENT RULES
================================

IMPORTANT:

Do not create a simple demonstration UI.

Build a fully functional application.

Every button must have a purpose.

Every dashboard module must work.

Do not use fake AI responses.

Do not use fake financial data.

Do not create buttons that do nothing.

If an external API is required,
create a proper integration interface.

Build the application in modular components.

Preserve existing working functionality
when making future modifications.

Prioritize performance on low-spec computers
and Android devices.

Do not unnecessarily introduce heavy
3D rendering technologies.

================================
FINAL OBJECTIVE
================================

Create MESA AI as a futuristic personal
AI operating system.

Mesa should become the owner's:

- Personal AI assistant.
- Digital secretary.
- Business assistant.
- Voice companion.
- Productivity manager.
- Intelligent workspace.

The final result must feel like a real
next-generation AI assistant application,
not an ordinary chatbot.
